attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report under Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Scoda Tubes Limited filed a Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report confirms that IPO proceeds were utilized as per the Offer Document with no deviations. Net proceeds stand at Rs 1,999.33 million. Capital expenditure for expanding production capacity utilized Rs 640.57 million, leaving Rs 129.33 million unutilized. Funding for incremental working capital requirements utilized Rs 795.87 million, with Rs 304.12 million remaining. General corporate purposes utilized Rs 109.98 million, leaving Rs 19.45 million unutilized. Issue expenses of Rs 200.67 million are fully utilized. Total unutilized proceeds amount to Rs 452.90 million. The company procured machines from vendors different from those specified in the Offer Document, which is permitted under the prospectus.

attchmntText: Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
Scoda Tubes Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
Scoda Tubes Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
